english.note: Use this when the subject is the owner or provider letting a property to someone else, especially when naming the tenant.

examples.english: We rent our flat to someone; the tenant is Ming.
examples.traditional: 我哋間屋租畀人住，個租客係阿明。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 zou1 bei2 jan4 zyu6 go3 zou1 haak3 hai6 aa3 ming4
